description: Header file defining structures, enums, and function declarations for parsing JPEG images, specifically baseline sequential JPEGs, including marker definitions, parsing result structures, and external references.

classes.name: JpegHuffmanTable
classes.description: Structure representing a JPEG Huffman table with validity flag, code lengths, and code values.

classes.name: JpegQuantizationTable
classes.description: Structure representing a JPEG quantization table with validity flag and quantization values.

classes.name: JpegComponent
classes.description: Structure representing a JPEG image component with ID, sampling factors, and quantization table selector.

classes.name: JpegFrameHeader
classes.description: Structure containing information about the JPEG image frame, including dimensions and components.

classes.name: JpegScanHeader
classes.description: Structure representing the scan header in JPEG, including component selectors and DC/AC selectors.

classes.name: JpegParseResult
classes.description: Aggregated structure holding the result of JPEG parsing, including headers, tables, restart interval, data pointers, and sizes.

methods.name: ParseJpegPicture
methods.description: Function to parse a JPEG picture buffer, validating header and baseline sequential process, outputting parsed result.

methods.name: ParseJpegStream
methods.description: Function to parse the first image of a JPEG stream buffer, validating header and baseline sequential process, outputting parsed result.
